Class StripeTransactionSelectorTest

@IsTest
private class StripeTransactionSelectorTest

Test class for StripeTransactionSelector. Validates methods for querying Stripe Transaction records including individual transaction retrieval, bulk transaction queries, and filtering transactions without associated payments.
